stories.title: Memory Tax: Dissecting the Net Value of Agent Memory

stories.title: VibeVideoBench: Evaluating Multimodal Agents on Code-Driven Video Generation
stories.summary: Diffusion video models produce striking clips, but they cannot reliably render an exact formula, a correct chart, a rule-consistent game or narration synchronized to on-screen events. A different route is emerging: multimodal agents that write code to render every frame and synthesize every sound. We introduce VibeVideoBench, a benchmark for evaluating agents on code-driven video generation.
